# mongodb

MongoDB access patterns - bounded finds, filtered writes, aggregation pipelines; the model mongo adapter measures call sites against these.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-DATA-011` | medium | MongoDB find/aggregate without a limit |
| `AF-DATA-012` | critical | MongoDB filtered write with an empty filter |
